records.prompt:

Asset type: one 16:9 photorealistic Notchscape architectural background, full photographic scene.

Recompose naturally so BOTH complete outer wings, central dome including its lantern and tiny Statue of Freedom, and the lowest MAIN terrace steps all fit with clear margins. Architecture should be center-right around x=68%, and the entire top-to-bottom structure should occupy approximately y=35% to y=64%, with its highest statue at y35% and main terrace base at y64%. The whole building must end before x=92%, with real open space to its right. A very shallow horizontal center crop retaining only y=34%-66% must preserve the complete main structure. Keep real Capitol proportions; do not squash, flatten, trim or distort the dome, wings or steps to make them fit.
Preserve the same convincing rich navy softly layered cloudy blue-hour sky, realistic warm amber architectural uplighting on white stone, restrained contrast, natural photographic detail, quiet dark lawn and tree foreground left. Add natural sky and dark lawn as necessary for the more distant view. No White House, no invented extra architecture, no collage, panels, text, logos, captions, watermarks, flags, crowds, event staging, scaffolding, oversaturated colors or CGI. Single wide 16:9 real photographic scene.
